description: Proposed mansard roof to create two extra rooms, increase of outrigger
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d4790a1f-7fff-110c-6e3a-89309609ad88"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">In the absence of a Unilateral Undertaking or a Section 106 Agreement to secure appropriate rent levels in accordance with the Local Housing Allowance, the development would fail to secure affordable rent levels, contrary to policy LP22 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5300943d-7fff-a8a3-5f28-138be6ac8788"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">In the absence of the provision of adequate cycle storage, the proposal fails to promote sustainable transport modes. The development would, therefore, be contrary to policies LP41 (Liveable Neighbourhoods), LP42 (Walking and Cycling), and LP43 (Transport and Development) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and policies T2 (Healthy streets), T4 (</span></span>Assessing and mitigating transport impacts), and T5 (Cycling) of the London Plan (2021).  </p><div><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></div>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-50fa7b2d-7fff-bfea-5d27-a024a9d660b5"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">By reason of the inadequate bathroom facilities for the second floor bedroom and failing to demonstrate adequate outlook for all bedrooms and a lack of communal spaces, the proposed development fails to be of a high standard to provide primary functions and encourage social amenity. The proposal would result in a poor and substandard form of accommodation, detrimental to the living conditions of future occupiers, and would, therefore, conflict with policy LP22 (House in Multiple Occupation (HMO)) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-8c00a3ac-7fff-6152-cfbe-00e56807227a"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">In the absence of a Unilateral Undertaking or a Section 106 Agreement securing appropriate mitigation by restricting future occupiers of the development from obtaining parking permits within the Controlled Parking Zone, the proposed development would likely exacerbate existing parking stress and congestion on the surrounding highway network. The development would, therefore, be contrary to policies LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car-Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and policies T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) and T6 (Car parking) of the London Plan (2021).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-daa1b866-7fff-3a08-3ab8-24a321c2b7d0"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">By virtue of the scale and form of the mansard roof and rear outrigger extension,&nbsp; the development would result in a poorly designed, overly large, prominent, and discordant roof extension that would be harmful to the appearance of the host property as well as the architectural character and integrity of the terrace, which it forms part of.&nbsp; The development would, therefore, be contrary to policies D1 (<span id="docs-internal-guid-5db7a1c7-7fff-3ab9-a4b2-751a25089dc6"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">London’s form, character and capacity for growth), </span></span>D3 (</span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach</span>), and D4 (Delivering good design) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and the guidance as contained within Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).</p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b758f945-7fff-a9fe-91cd-541ddbd80248"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-8ae2f404-7fff-3bf7-a1d9-a932bb4d3e81"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Insufficient information, such as the submission of a BRE daylight and sunlight assessment, has been provided to demonstrate that the proposed rear outrigger extension, by reason of its size, design, and position, would not result in loss of daylight to No.17 Blurton Road. As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies D3 (Optimising Site capacity through the design-led approach) and D6 (Housing Quality and Standards) of the London Plan (2021), and policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and the guidance contained within Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).</span></span></p>
